scripts.clean-codepush: rm -rf codepush && mkdir codepush && mkdir codepush/android && mkdir codepush/ios
scripts.bundle-ios: yarn clean-codepush && node ../../node_modules/.bin/react-native bundle --platform ios --entry-file index.js --bundle-output ./CodePush/ios/main.jsbundle --assets-dest ./CodePush/ios --dev false --reset-cache
scripts.bundle-android: yarn clean-codepush && node ../../node_modules/.bin/react-native bundle --platform android --entry-file index.js --bundle-output ./CodePush/android/index.android.bundle --assets-dest ./CodePush/android --dev false --reset-cache
scripts.codepush:ios:staging: APP_ENV=stag yarn bundle-ios && appcenter codepush release -a app_team/NClub-ios -d Staging -m -t 2.0.3 -c ./CodePush/ios
scripts.codepush:android:staging: APP_ENV=stag yarn bundle-android && appcenter codepush release -a app_team/NClub-android -d Staging -m -t 2.0.3 -c ./CodePush/android
scripts.codepush:ios:staging2: APP_ENV=stag2 yarn bundle-ios && appcenter codepush release -a app_team/NClub-ios -d StagingAlt -m -t 2.0.3 -c ./CodePush/ios
scripts.codepush:android:staging2: APP_ENV=stag2 yarn bundle-android && appcenter codepush release -a app_team/NClub-android -d StagingAlt -m -t 2.0.3 -c ./CodePush/android
scripts.codepush:ios:prod: yarn bundle-ios && appcenter codepush release -a app_team/NClub-ios -d Production -m -t 2.0.3 -c ./CodePush/ios
scripts.codepush:android:prod: yarn bundle-android && appcenter codepush release -a app_team/NClub-android -d Production -m -t 2.0.3 -c ./CodePush/android
scripts.codepush:ios:pre: APP_ENV=pre yarn bundle-ios && appcenter codepush release -a app_team/NClub-ios -d Predeployment -m -t 2.0.3 -c ./CodePush/ios
scripts.codepush:android:pre: APP_ENV=pre yarn bundle-android && appcenter codepush release -a app_team/NClub-android -d Predeployment -m -t 2.0.3 -c ./CodePush/android
scripts.codepush:ios:soft: APP_ENV=soft yarn bundle-ios && appcenter codepush release -a app_team/NClub-ios -d Softlaunch -m -t 2.0.3 -c ./CodePush/ios
scripts.codepush:android:soft: APP_ENV=soft yarn bundle-android && appcenter codepush release -a app_team/NClub-android -d Softlaunch -m -t 2.0.3 -c ./CodePush/android
